title: Framatome
summary: French nuclear-equipment and services group owned by EDF.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Framatome designs and maintains nuclear reactors, supplies fuel assemblies and components, and services the French and international reactor fleet. It is central to EDF's new-build and life-extension programmes. Ownership by EDF aligns it with French energy policy.

Technology Exposure

  • Reactor design and components
  • Nuclear fuel assemblies
  • Maintenance and life extension

What To Watch

  • EDF new-build programme
  • Fuel contracts
  • European reactor life extensions

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
